recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: French Polynesia. Parliamentary democracy (assembly of french polynesia); an overseas collectivity of france.
rulers: President Emmanuel MACRON (since 14 May 2017), represented by High Commissioner of the Republic Alexander ROCHATTE (since 1 September 2025); President of French Polynesia Moetai BROTHERSON (since 12 May 2023)
government: parliamentary democracy (Assembly of French Polynesia); an overseas collectivity of France
economy: small, territorial-island tourism-based economy; large French financing; lower EU import duties; Pacific Islands Forum member; fairly resilient from COVID-19; oil-dependent infrastructure GDP (PPP): $6.007 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2015 dollars
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
